trainer.dialogueBefore: Swimmer Dillon: I swam all the way over from Route 220 without stopping! Mind if I battle while I rest?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Swimmer Dillon: I'll just float on my back for a bit. Ahh, that's better.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Swimmer Vanessa: My Golduck swims faster than any Pokémon I know. Want to see?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Swimmer Vanessa: Fast isn't the same as strong. I'll remember that.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Fisherman Cory: Three casts, three Finneon, all before breakfast. Want to meet them?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Fisherman Cory: They'll grow. And when they do, you'd better watch out.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Collector Ivan: I've gathered rare Pokémon from all over. Let me show you the jewel of my collection!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Collector Ivan: My jewel has lost its sparkle. A good polish, and it'll shine again.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Jake: Staraptor and I flew out over the sea looking for a strong trainer. Looks like we found one!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Jake: A good battle is worth the trip, win or lose.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Shannon: This far from the cities, there's nobody to hold back for. Give it everything!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Shannon: You gave it everything, all right. More than I did!
